Hedging statements utilize probability structures like 'It is likely that'.

whitelisted_false_positives.pattern: If S + had V3, S + would + V

whitelisted_false_positives.pattern: Much / many with There is / There are

whitelisted_false_positives.pattern: It is vital/important/imperative that + S + be/bare V

whitelisted_false_positives.pattern: Phenomena / phenomenons plural test with There are
